inlines.v: ANEM'ONE, ANEM'ONY, noun [Gr. from wind.] Wind-flower; a genus of plants of numerous species. Some of the species are cultivated in gardens, of which their double flowers are among the most elegant ornaments. Sea anemone See Animal Flower.
